from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentClassification(BaseModel):
    """Represents the classification result for a single document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The actual title of the judgment document, e.g. 《判决文书1》")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The specific case cause assigned to this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all parsed documents in the current batch."""
    documents: list[DocumentClassification] = Field(description="List of document classification records")
